sources.title: Windows LAPS overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Credential Guard：設定、執行狀態與相容性證據
related.titleEn: Credential Guard: configured state, runtime and compatibility
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：10與20次/日只代表均勻平均，離線例外另列；未授權取用拒絕，教材完全不含真實密碼。 交付300台合成輪替摘要、取用權限矩陣與不含秘密的稽核範例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Treat 10 and 20/day as uniform averages with offline exceptions separate; reject unauthorized retrieval and include no real passwords. Deliver synthetic fleet rotation summaries, a retrieval-permission matrix and secret-free audit examples.
related.difference: 為40台虛構Windows工作站列硬體能力、政策設定、執行狀態與相容性案例；區分「已要求啟用」與「確認運作」。
related.differenceEn: Inventory hardware capability, policy, runtime and compatibility for 40 fictional Windows workstations; distinguish requested enablement from verified operation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 均勻分散排程的平均每日輪替量=裝置數/週期日數；峰值、離線裝置與重試另算，輪替成功不代表備份可取用。 教學300台裝置、30日輪替週期，排程均勻且無離線。 300/30=10次輪替/日；週期改15日後300/15=20次/日。
可驗證覆蓋率=確認執行且通過相容性測試的裝置/範圍裝置；這是部署證據比例，不是可防止所有憑證攻擊的機率。 40台範圍裝置中34台有執行與相容性證據，6台仍待處理。 34/40×100=85%；補修4台後38/40×100=95%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With evenly spread scheduling, average daily rotations=devices/period days; peaks, offline devices and retries are separate, and rotation success does not prove retrievable backup. A teaching fleet has 300 devices on a 30-day evenly spread rotation cycle, with no offline devices. 300/30=10 rotations/day; a 15-day cycle gives 20/day.

Verified coverage is devices running the feature and passing compatibility tests divided by in-scope devices; this is deployment evidence, not universal credential-attack prevention probability. Of 40 in-scope devices, 34 have runtime and compatibility evidence and six remain pending. 34/40×100=85%; repairing four gives 38/40×100=95%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Semgrep：以正負樣本驗證靜態規則
related.titleEn: Semgrep: validating static rules with positive and negative fixtures
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：10與20次/日只代表均勻平均，離線例外另列；未授權取用拒絕，教材完全不含真實密碼。 交付300台合成輪替摘要、取用權限矩陣與不含秘密的稽核範例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Treat 10 and 20/day as uniform averages with offline exceptions separate; reject unauthorized retrieval and include no real passwords. Deliver synthetic fleet rotation summaries, a retrieval-permission matrix and secret-free audit examples.
related.difference: 為一條本機規則建立應命中、應不命中、巢狀與變數重新命名四類測試，再檢查誤報。
related.differenceEn: Build expected-match, expected-nonmatch, nested and renamed-variable fixtures for one local rule, then examine false positives.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 均勻分散排程的平均每日輪替量=裝置數/週期日數；峰值、離線裝置與重試另算，輪替成功不代表備份可取用。 教學300台裝置、30日輪替週期，排程均勻且無離線。 300/30=10次輪替/日；週期改15日後300/15=20次/日。
Precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；語法匹配不等於跨函式資料流證明。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20個自編片段中8個應命中；規則找到6個真陽性並誤報3個，漏2個。 Precision=6/9=66.6667%，recall=6/8=75%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With evenly spread scheduling, average daily rotations=devices/period days; peaks, offline devices and retries are separate, and rotation success does not prove retrievable backup. A teaching fleet has 300 devices on a 30-day evenly spread rotation cycle, with no offline devices. 300/30=10 rotations/day; a 15-day cycle gives 20/day.

Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); syntax matching is not proof of interprocedural data flow. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twenty original snippets, eight should match; the rule yields six true positives, three false positives and two false negatives. Precision=6/9=66.6667% and recall=6/8=75%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
